fix(camellia): adjust device page scroll layout

Summary:
- Move the desktop list height cap onto the whole device list card.
- Keep the detail panel content-driven while constraining the property list
  scroller to the available desktop viewport space.

Rationale:
- The previous layout capped only the list card body, so the card header and
  detail property list could still make the page taller than the shell and
  expose blank page-level scrolling.
- This keeps the left side stable and lets the right side follow the property
  list content without forcing both panes to the same height.

Tests:
- just camellia check
- just camellia smoke (reports no smoke scripts are provided)
